Business domain map

What the product is for, how it earns, and what every domain term means.

Overview

Confidence: Medium. This synthesis is seeded from the project's legacy discovery documents (.context/business/business-model.md, .context/business/domain-glossary.md), which themselves derive from the target project's SRS and functional specs. The three most load-bearing entities (Workspace, Module, Run) were spot-verified against the live migration history in the target repo (upex-bunkai-tms) on 2026-10-10; drift found is recorded in discovery-gaps. Everything else remains legacy-seeded and unverified against schema.

Problem statement

Existing test management systems (Xray, Zephyr, TestRail, qTest) act as document vaults: they store test cases as monolithic step blobs, enforce no structural traceability between tests and requirements, and delegate bug tracking to external tools such as Jira. The result is duplicated steps, broken traceability, maintenance rot, and reports that no longer reflect reality (.context/business/business-model.md §Problem Statement).

Bunkai's thesis is that a data model enforcing structural traceability — ATC anchored to User Story and Acceptance Criterion, chained into Tests, executed as Runs, with native Bugs — makes good QA the path of least resistance. The schema itself carries the invariant: for example atcs.user_story_id is a mandatory foreign key (supabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql), so an unanchored test component cannot exist.

Target users

The product serves indie QA engineers, mid-market organizations, regulated-industry enterprises, and a QA training audience (.context/business/business-model.md §Customer Segments). In the product's own terms, day-to-day actors are workspace members with four RBAC roles — viewer, member, admin, owner — plus automated executors (human, agent, ci) that produce Run results (supabase/migrations/0001_tenancy.sql, supabase/migrations/0031_runs.sql).

Value proposition

What the product already delivers: reusable Atomic Test Components (ATCs) instead of copy-pasted steps, structural traceability enforced at the data-model layer, three execution modes (manual, agentic, CI-automated) against one Test definition, native bug filing anchored to Module + ATC + Run, an API-first design (REST route handlers under app/api/v1/ in the target repo), and an open-core distribution model with a community plan default on every workspace (.context/business/business-model.md, supabase/migrations/0001_tenancy.sql).

Business model

Business Model Canvas synthesised from the legacy business-model document and partially corroborated against the target repo's schema. The workspaces.plan column (community | cloud | enterprise) and the Stripe-backed billing tables (billing_checkout_sessions, stripe_webhook_events) are the strongest hard evidence of the open-core revenue shape.

Key metrics (MVP)

Metric Target Testing implication
Activation (workspaces with ≥1 Module + ≥1 ATC + ≥1 Test + ≥1 Run within 24h) ≥60% Test the full “first run” journey end-to-end.
ATC reuse ratio (tests-per-ATC) at day 30 <1.0 Verify ATC chaining across Tests; edits propagate.
Structural correctness (% ATCs anchored to US + AC) 100% Data-model invariant — unanchored ATCs must be rejected.
Three-mode adoption (≥2 modes within 30 days) TBD API-first design: all UI actions have REST endpoints.

QA relevance

Business aspect Testing implication
ATC reuse + chaining Core features to test: ATC anchoring invariant, Test step chaining, edit propagation.
Structural traceability Traceability invariants are schema-enforced; regression must probe the boundary (cross-project injection, archived content).
Run state machine Manual/agent/CI execution modes share one state machine; mode-specific paths need per-mode coverage.
Native bugs Bug lifecycle (open → in_progress → resolved → closed) and provenance links (run/step/ATC) must be tested in-product.
Open-core tiers Edition-gated features (plan = community/cloud/enterprise) must be tested per tier.
Jira import Story import via external_id with case-insensitive uniqueness; sync depth unverified.

Workspace

Business name Code identifier UI label Table / collection Found in
Workspace workspace Not verified (no i18n bundle) workspaces supabase/migrations/0001_tenancy.sql

Business meaning: The organization tenant. Every piece of product data ultimately resolves to exactly one workspace; Row Level Security makes an active membership the only door to that data. New workspaces default to the community plan.

Verified schema notes (2026-10-10): the row carries id, globally unique kebab-case slug, name, owner_user_id (FK to auth.users), plan (community | cloud | enterprise), and created_at. The legacy glossary omitted owner_user_id and plan — see discovery-gaps.

Module

Business name Code identifier UI label Table / collection Found in
Module module Not verified (no i18n bundle) modules supabase/migrations/0002_projects_modules.sql, 0014_module_soft_delete.sql

Business meaning: A first-class node of the test-surface tree — not a folder. Modules carry their own metrics and anchor user stories, ATCs, and bugs. The tree is keyed by a materialized slash-separated path and is hard-capped at depth 6 by a CHECK constraint on path segments.

Verified schema notes (2026-10-10): row = id, project_id, parent_module_id (self-FK), path (unique per project), name, position, created_at, archived_at (soft delete, added in 0014). The archive cascade function bunkai_archive_module_subtree (latest replacement in 0023) soft-deletes descendant modules, their user stories, acceptance criteria, and ATCs — it does not cover tests or bugs, contrary to legacy business rule BR-003 (drift recorded in discovery-gaps). Renames rebuild the materialized path of the whole subtree (bunkai_update_module).

UI labels: Not verified — no i18n translation bundle (checked 2026-10-10).

Related terms: UserStory, ATC, Bug, Project

Abbreviations: none.

Structure: attributes, relationships, depth invariant and archive lifecycle belong to the business-data-context map — that map is still a placeholder; tracked in discovery-gaps.

ATC

Business name Code identifier UI label Table / collection Found in
ATC / Atomic Test Component atc Not verified (no i18n bundle) atcs supabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql

Business meaning: The core primitive — a reusable, atomic unit of verification with ordered steps (atc_steps) and assertions (atc_assertions). Tests chain ATCs instead of copy-pasting steps; this is what makes reuse and traceability possible.

Verified schema notes (2026-10-10): project_id, module_id and user_story_id are all mandatory FKs — the “anchored to a User Story” invariant is a NOT NULL column, stronger than the legacy glossary's description of a module-only anchor. The row also carries slug (unique per project), layer, version, a roll-up status, tags, and a tsvector for search. AC anchoring remains an M:N join (atc_acceptance_criteria). Layer enum UI | API | Unit matches the glossary.

UI labels: Not verified — no i18n translation bundle (checked 2026-10-10).

Related terms: Test, AcceptanceCriterion, Module, Run

Test

Test test Not verified (no i18n bundle) tests supabase/migrations/0024_tests.sql

Run

Business name Code identifier UI label Table / collection Found in
Run / Execution run Not verified (no i18n bundle) runs supabase/migrations/0031_runs.sql

Business meaning: One execution of a Test against a named project environment, performed by a human, an agent, or a CI job. At start, the whole chain is frozen into snapshot rows (run_atcs, run_steps) so later edits to the Test or its ATCs cannot rewrite history.

Verified schema notes (2026-10-10) — this section describes CURRENT reality, which drifted from the legacy glossary:

  • Statuses are running | passed | failed | aborted. There is no created state: bunkai_create_run inserts the row already running.
  • The executor column is executor_mode with values human | agent | ci (the glossary said executor_type human/agent), plus executor_user_id for the acting user.
  • Idempotency is start_token: the same (test_id, start_token) within a 24h window returns the existing Run (domain-level replay protection). A separate generic idempotency_keys table (0009) covers POST replay protection; the glossary's unique (test_id, idempotency_key) column does not exist.
  • The Run row denormalizes workspace_id, project_id, a test_title snapshot, and an optimistic-lock version.
  • A scheduled inactivity sweep (0075, pg_cron) closes abandoned Runs as aborted with a system-generated reason, so a Run can never sit running forever.

UI labels: Not verified — no i18n translation bundle (checked 2026-10-10).

Related terms: Test, ATC, Bug, Project

Bug

Business name Code identifier UI label Table / collection Found in
Bug / Defect bug Not verified (no i18n bundle) bugs supabase/migrations/0046_bugs.sql

Business meaning: A native, in-product defect. Workspace, project and module are always required; run / run-step / ATC ids are optional provenance links frozen at filing time, so a bug filed from a historical run stays valid even if that run's source content changes. Jira is not required — bugs live here.

Verified schema notes (2026-10-10): severity is P1 | P2 | P3 | P4 (matches the glossary); status is open | in_progress | resolved | closed — there is no rejected state in the schema (drift from the glossary, recorded in discovery-gaps). evidence_urls is capped at 10 entries; titles are trimmed and limited to 5–200 chars. Consistency of workspace/project/module/run/atc provenance is enforced by both the create RPC and a table trigger.

UI labels: Not verified — no i18n translation bundle (checked 2026-10-10).

Related terms: Module, ATC, Run, User

Enumerations

Code-constant values as declared in CHECK constraints. Where the live schema drifted from the legacy glossary, the CURRENT values are shown and the drift is recorded in discovery-gaps.

Workspace Role — workspace_members.role

Value Business meaning Usage context
owner Full control: billing, workspace deletion, managing roles. workspace_members.role
admin Manage members, projects, integrations. workspace_members.role
member Create/edit ATCs, Tests, Runs, Bugs. workspace_members.role
viewer Read-only: dashboards, reports. workspace_members.role

Workspace Member Status — workspace_members.status

Value Business meaning Usage context
active Membership unlocked — the only state that passes RLS. workspace_members.status
invited Invite exists; access not yet granted. workspace_members.status
suspended Access revoked administratively without removing history. workspace_members.status

Workspace Plan — workspaces.plan

Value Business meaning Usage context
community Free open-core tier; the default for every new workspace. workspaces.plan
cloud Hosted paid tier (per-seat revenue model). workspaces.plan
enterprise Annual-license tier. workspaces.plan

User Story Status — user_stories.status

Value Business meaning Usage context
draft Story still being written; not yet test-anchorable. user_stories.status
ready_to_test Ready-to-test gate passed; test content may anchor. user_stories.status

Run Status — runs.status

Value Business meaning Usage context
running Execution created and in progress (also the insert default — there is no separate created state). runs.status
passed All chain positions passed. runs.status
failed At least one position/step failed. runs.status
aborted Stopped mid-execution — by a person, or by the inactivity sweep. runs.status

Run Executor Mode — runs.executor_mode

Value Business meaning Usage context
human A signed-in member executes manually. runs.executor_mode
agent An AI/agentic executor performs the run. runs.executor_mode
ci A CI pipeline performs the run. runs.executor_mode

Bug Severity — bugs.severity

Value Business meaning Usage context
P1 Critical — blocks release. bugs.severity
P2 Major — significant functionality broken. bugs.severity
P3 Minor — non-critical issue. bugs.severity
P4 Trivial — cosmetic/enhancement. bugs.severity

Bug Status — bugs.status

Value Business meaning Usage context
open Reported, not yet triaged into active work. bugs.status
in_progress Being worked on. bugs.status
resolved Fix deployed. bugs.status
closed Verified fixed (or terminal). No rejected value exists in the schema. bugs.status

ATC Layer — atcs.layer

Value Business meaning Usage context
UI Browser-based interaction (e.g. Playwright). atcs.layer
API HTTP request/response validation. atcs.layer
Unit Isolated function/module test. atcs.layer

Run Position / Step Status — run_atcs.status, run_steps.status

Value Business meaning Usage context
pending Not yet executed in this run. run_atcs.status, run_steps.status
passed Behavior matches expected. run_atcs.status, run_steps.status
failed Assertion mismatch or error. run_atcs.status, run_steps.status
blocked Cannot execute (dependency, environment issue). run_atcs.status, run_steps.status
skipped Deliberately not executed (e.g. abort/finish sweeps remaining positions). run_atcs.status, run_steps.status

Discovery gaps

What could not be verified, and where the legacy glossary drifted from the live schema (checked 2026-10-10).

Open gaps

  • Overview figures deferred: diagram-design style gate not resolved (no .diagram-design marker); figures can be added per-section later.
  • Customer Relationships canvas block: Unknown — requires user input (no evidence found in legacy docs or schema).
  • Actual pricing tiers/limits per plan not finalized (target TBD in legacy docs).
  • Self-hosted Docker Compose edition not implemented yet (legacy gap).
  • Agentic and CI execution runners: schema accepts executor_mode agent/ci, but whether those runners are functional end-to-end is unverified (legacy called agentic “Phase 2”).
  • CI/CD adapter imports not built (legacy gap).
  • UI labels unverified: the target repo ships no i18n translation bundle (checked 2026-10-10); every term's “UI labels” line is therefore a gap, not a claim.
  • The business-data-context map is still a placeholder — every term's “Structure” pointer awaits its generation (project-context mode data).
  • Bidirectional Jira sync: external_id/external_url columns and a uniqueness index are verified (0003, 0016); full bidirectional sync behaviour is not.
  • Glossary coverage predates newer tables now in the schema — project_environments (0031), milestones (0064), notifications (0053), test_plans (0073), workspace_exports (0083), workspace_deletions (0084). Term sections should be extended when the data map is generated.

Drift found (legacy claim vs current schema, 2026-10-10)

  • workspace_members.status: glossary said active/inactive; schema check is active | invited | suspended (0001_tenancy.sql).
  • workspaces: glossary omitted owner_user_id and plan (0001_tenancy.sql).
  • runs: no created status (rows insert as running); executor_type renamed executor_mode with a third value ci; idempotency is a start_token + 24h window, not a unique idempotency_key column (0031_runs.sql).
  • bugs.status: no rejected value — schema is open | in_progress | resolved | closed (0046_bugs.sql).
  • Run position/step statuses: glossary said pass/fail/block; schema is pending | passed | failed | blocked | skipped on both run_atcs and run_steps (0031_runs.sql).
  • BR-003 module archive cascade: glossary said it covers US, ATC, Tests and Bugs; the current bunkai_archive_module_subtree covers modules, user stories, acceptance criteria and ATCs only — tests and bugs are not cascaded (0023_module_activity_log.sql, latest replacement).
  • atcs: glossary listed module_id as the anchor; schema makes project_id and user_story_id mandatory too and adds slug, version and a roll-up status column (0004_atcs.sql).
